## Motivation

Enable SGLang's RL features on Intel XPU (in addition to CUDA/ROCm) and enable the corresponding tests.

**Depends on #40720.** `test_update_weights_from_tensor.py`, `test_weight_checker_e2e.py` and `test_patch_torch.py` send device tensors through `MultiprocessingSerializer`. XPU has no tensor IPC, so on XPU these tests need #40720 (XPU tensors staged through host shared memory). Please merge this PR after #40720. #40720 also edits `test_patch_torch.py`; the only overlap is the `sglang.srt.utils` import line.

Source changes:
- weight_checker.py: synchronize through `get_device_module()` instead of `torch.cuda`.
- weight_checker_comparator.py: move chunks to the current device instead of `.cuda()`.
- indexer_topk.py: enable the capturer on XPU (`Indexer.forward_xpu` runs the same capture sites as CUDA).
- attention_hook.py: with deterministic inference and TP > 1 on XPU, set `CCL_ALLREDUCE=recursive_doubling`. oneCCL's default XPU all-reduce kernels switch by message size and are not batch-invariant at 3+ ranks, and CUDA's `NCCL_ALGO=allreduce:tree` has no effect on XCCL. A proper oneCCL fix will be tracked separately.
- weight_updater.py: restore `model_config.model_path` on every failure exit of `update_weights_from_disk`. Not XPU-specific: a failed update left the path on the rejected checkpoint, so the rollback reload read it again.

### Supported and Verified following Features

- Weight refit from a distributed trainer over XCCL (Engine and Server; tp1dp1, tp1dp2, tp2dp1, tp2dp2; default and flattened_bucket load formats)
- Live refit with `pause_generation` in `in_place` and `retract` modes
- Weight update from disk, including rollback on missing or malformed weights
- Weights checker (snapshot / compare / checksum)
- Routed-experts capture (MoE, TP4, deterministic)
- Indexer-topk capture (DSA)
- Release / resume memory occupation (sleep / wake)
- Deterministic inference with TP > 1

Test changes:
- `test_update_weights_from_tensor.py`, `test_weight_checker_e2e.py`: device-agnostic (`get_device()` / `get_device_module()`) and registered for `nightly-xpu-1-gpu`. `test_weight_checker_e2e.py` also calls `monkey_patch_torch_reductions()` in `setUpClass`, as SGLang's own clients do, because it serializes tensors itself; with #40720 this routes XPU tensors through host shared memory.
- `test_patch_torch.py`: picks `ZE_AFFINITY_MASK` on XPU.
- `test_multi_instance_release_memory_occupation.py`: device-agnostic; skipped on XPU because `ProcessGroupXCCL` has no comm splitting.
- `test/manual/rl/test_xpu_rl.py`: manual XPU suite covering the distributed refit matrix, disk refit, and routed-experts / indexer-topk capture. Distributed updates are wrapped in `begin_weight_update` / `end_weight_update`, as required since #40777.

## Results

Intel Arc Pro B60, rebased on main @ b72da1b817.

| Suite | Cards | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `TestUpdateWeightsFromDisk` (TP1/TP2, deterministic, incl. failure rollback) | 2 | 6/6 passed, 93 subtests |
| `TestReturnRoutedExpertsXPU` (Qwen3-30B-A3B, TP4, deterministic) | 4 | 4/4 passed |
| Distributed refit matrix (18 cases: tp1dp1, tp1dp2, tp2dp1 × Engine/Server × pause modes × load formats) | 3 | 18/18 passed |
| Distributed refit matrix, tp2dp2 (6 cases: Engine/Server × pause modes × load formats) | 5 | 6/6 passed |
| `TestReturnIndexerTopkXPU` | 2 | 3/3 passed |
| `test_update_weights_from_tensor.py` (TP1 and TP2), with #40720 applied | 2 | 5/5 passed |
| `test_weight_checker_e2e.py`, with #40720 applied | 1 | 9/9 passed |
| `test_patch_torch.py`, with #40720 applied | 2 | 1/1 passed |

## Accuracy Tests

Weight correctness after refit is checked bit-exactly, not by comparing generated text (measured before the rebase):
- After alternating refits between Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-1B base, the per-rank, per-tensor checksums from `/weights_checker` matched references from servers that loaded each checkpoint from disk: 0 mismatched tensors over 35 cycles, on both TP ranks.
- Requests that kept generating across live updates (`retract` and `in_place`) had correct weight-version spans: 0 violations in 3,648 requests.
- `TestUpdateWeightsFromDisk` compares logprobs to 1e-4 after refit (above).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

RL rollout/refit performance with a simulated trainer (not end-to-end training throughput), measured before the rebase. Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct BF16; trainer on 1 card, SGLang TP2 on 2 cards; 5 warmup + 30 measured cycles; median / p95.

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Refit, 2.30 GiB BF16 over XCCL | 0.174 / 0.175 s (effective payload ~14 GB/s) |
| Rollout, 64 x 256 tokens, triton / intel_xpu (page size 128) | 2,279 / 2,754 tok/s (median) |
| Variable-length rollout, up to 1,024 tokens, triton | 2,179 / 2,298 tok/s |
| Pause -> refit -> continue control latency, 64 requests in flight | 0.19 / 0.29-0.32 s |
| Sleep/wake: release / resume weights / resume KV cache | 0.117 / 0.054 / 0.203 s (medians) |
| Refit with memory saver on | 0.266 / 0.318 s |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+    while len(ports) < count:

+def _run_distributed_refit(
+    tp_size,
+    dp_size,
+    model_name,
+    backend,
+    state_dict_key_to_shape,
+    truncate_size,
+    checking_parameters,
+    load_format=None,
+    pause_generation_mode=None,

+    tie_word_embeddings = (
+        True if model_name == DEFAULT_SMALL_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST else False
+    )
+
+    print(
+        f"Testing model: {model_name} tp_size: {tp_size}, dp_size: {dp_size} backend: {backend}"
+    )
+    param_queue = mp.Queue()
+    results = {}
+    barrier = mp.Barrier(1 + dp_size)
+    group_port, *server_ports = _pick_free_ports(1 + dp_size)
+    ports = {"group": group_port, **dict(zip((1, 2), server_ports))}
+
+    context = mp.spawn(
+        init_process,
+        args=(
+            1 + tp_size * dp_size,
+            param_queue,
+            truncate_size,
+            state_dict_key_to_shape,
+            tp_size,
+            model_name,
+            backend,
+            checking_parameters,
+            tie_word_embeddings,
+            load_format,
+            barrier,
+            pause_generation_mode,
+            attention_backend,
+            ports,
+        ),
+        nprocs=1 + dp_size,
+        join=False,
+    )
+
+    while len(results) < 3 * (1 + dp_size):
+        try:
+            key, value = param_queue.get(timeout=5)
+            results[key] = value
+        except Exception:
+            if all(not p.is_alive() for p in context.processes):
+                break
+
+    context.join()
+
+    if len(results) != 3 * (1 + dp_size):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"Expected {3 * (1 + dp_size)} parameters but got {len(results)}"
+        )
+
+    params = {
+        "hf_instruct": results.get("hf_instruct_params"),
+        "hf_base": results.get("hf_base_params"),
+        "sgl_dp_1_instruct": results.get("sgl_dp_1_instruct_params"),
+        "sgl_dp_1_base": results.get("sgl_dp_1_base_params"),
+        "broadcast_time": results.get("broadcast_time"),
+        "update_sgl_dp_1_time": results.get("update_sgl_dp_1_time"),
+    }
+
+    if dp_size == 2:
+        dp2_params = {
+            "sgl_dp_2_instruct": results.get("sgl_dp_2_instruct_params"),
+            "sgl_dp_2_base": results.get("sgl_dp_2_base_params"),
+            "update_sgl_dp_2_time": results.get("update_sgl_dp_2_time"),
+        }
+        assert all(v is not None for v in dp2_params.values())
+        params.update(dp2_params)
+
+    # Check the correctness of weights update by verifying
+    # the weights of instruct model and base model.
+    for i in range(len(params["hf_instruct"])):
+        verify_params_close(
+            params["hf_instruct"][i],
+            params["sgl_dp_1_instruct"][i],
+            f"sgl_dp_1_instruct_params rank {i}",
+        )
+
+        verify_params_close(
+            params["hf_base"][i],
+            params["sgl_dp_1_base"][i],
+            f"sgl_dp_1_base_params rank {i}",
+        )
+
+        verify_params_not_close(
+            params["hf_instruct"][i],
+            params["hf_base"][i],
+            f"hf_instruct_params rank {i}",
+        )
+
+        if dp_size == 2:
+            verify_params_close(
+                params["hf_base"][i],
+                params["sgl_dp_2_base"][i],
+                f"sgl_dp_2_base_params rank {i}",
+            )
+            verify_params_close(
+                params["hf_instruct"][i],
+                params["sgl_dp_2_instruct"][i],
+                f"sgl_dp_2_instruct_params rank {i}",
+            )
+
+    assert len(params["hf_instruct"]) == len(params["hf_base"]), (
+        "hf_instruct_params and hf_base_params have different lengths"
+    )
+
+    # Check if the weights of lm_head are tied with embed_tokens.
+    params_to_check = [
+        (
+            params["hf_instruct"],
+            "lm_head.weight is not tied with embed_tokens.weight",
+        ),
+        (
+            params["hf_base"],
+            "lm_head.weight is not tied with embed_tokens.weight",
+        ),
+        (
+            params["sgl_dp_1_instruct"],
+            "lm_head.weight is not tied with embed_tokens.weight",
+        ),
+        (
+            params["sgl_dp_1_base"],
+            "lm_head.weight is not tied with embed_tokens.weight",
+        ),
+    ]
+
+    if dp_size == 2:
+        params_to_check.extend(
+            [
+                (
+                    params["sgl_dp_2_instruct"],
+                    "lm_head.weight is not tied with embed_tokens.weight",
+                ),
+                (
+                    params["sgl_dp_2_base"],
+                    "lm_head.weight is not tied with embed_tokens.weight",
+                ),
+            ]
+        )
+
+    assert_tied_weights(
+        [params for params, _ in params_to_check],
+        (
+            "lm_head.weight is not tied with embed_tokens.weight"
+            if tie_word_embeddings
+            else "lm_head.weight is tied with embed_tokens.weight"
+        ),
+        tie_word_embeddings,
+    )
+
+    # Time limit for broadcast and update on CI is 3 / 6
+    # On local H100, it's 1 / 2
+    time_limit = 3 if model_name == DEFAULT_SMALL_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST else 6
+
+    assert params["broadcast_time"] < time_limit, (
+        f"broadcast_time exceeds time limit {time_limit}s"
+    )
+
+    assert params["update_sgl_dp_1_time"] < time_limit, (
+        f"update_sgl_dp_one_time exceeds time limit {time_limit}s"
+    )
+
+    if dp_size == 2:
+        assert params["update_sgl_dp_2_time"] < time_limit, (
+            f"update_sgl_dp_two_time exceeds time limit {time_limit}s"
+        )
+
+    # Delete the context and close the parameter queue.
+    del context
+    param_queue.close()
+    param_queue.join_thread()
+    gc.collect()
+    torch.xpu.empty_cache()
